in_latin.name: Mauritius
in_latin.meaning: Mauritius, a Latin name of Moorish origin, means 'Moorish' or 'dark-skinned'
in_latin.long_meaning: Mauritius is a Latin name derived from the Greek name Μάύυτσ, meaning 'Moorish' or 'dark-skinned'. In Christian tradition, the name Mauritius is associated with Saint Maurice, a 3rd-century Roman soldier who was martyred with his companions in Switzerland. The name has been used in various forms throughout history, including in medieval Europe and in modern times as a given name for boys
